# Spatial structure - Evolvable interaction values

Varies vertical transmission rate across a range of spatial structures.
This experiment focuses on detour graphs with variable proportions of locations in the clique versus detour path.
Additionally, we vary the "width" of the detour path (creating a "straw" structure that connects to the clique on both ends).

## Dependencies and setup

Load required libraries.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(khroma)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(janitor)
```

Configure variable to hold path to working directory.

```{r}
# Build relative path from R's working directory to what is actually the working
# directory for this experiment.
experiment_slug <- "2026-11-11-spatial-evo-interaction"
working_directory <- paste(
  "experiments",
  experiment_slug,
  "analysis",
  sep = "/"
)
```

Configure default plot theme, create directory for saving plots.

```{r}
# Use the cowplot theme as our default for ggplots
theme_set(theme_cowplot())
# Create directory to save plots
plot_dir <- paste(
  working_directory,
  "plots",
  sep = "/"
)
dir.create(
  plot_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
```

### Load and preprocess data

```{r}
tasks <- c("NOT", "NAND", "OR_NOT", "AND", "OR", "AND_NOT", "NOR", "XOR", "EQU")
max_pop_size <- 100 * 100
threshold <- 0.025 * max_pop_size
num_replicates <- 10
```

#### Summary data

```{r}
summary_data_path <- paste(
  working_directory,
  "data",
  "summary.csv",
  sep = "/"
)
summary_data <- read_csv(summary_data_path)
# Do any universal preprocessing
summary_data <- summary_data %>%
  mutate(
    SEED = as.factor(SEED),
    START_MOI = as.factor(START_MOI),
    VERTICAL_TRANSMISSION = as.factor(VERTICAL_TRANSMISSION),
    HEALTH_TYPE = as.factor(HEALTH_TYPE),
    HEALTH_INTERACTION_CHANCE = as.factor(HEALTH_INTERACTION_CHANCE),
    MUTUALIST_CYCLE_GAIN_PROP = as.factor(MUTUALIST_CYCLE_GAIN_PROP),
    PARASITE_CYCLE_LOSS_PROP = as.factor(PARASITE_CYCLE_LOSS_PROP),
    PARASITE_BASE_CYCLE_PROP = as.factor(PARASITE_BASE_CYCLE_PROP),
    MUTUALIST_CYCLE_DONATE_MULTIPLIER = as.factor(MUTUALIST_CYCLE_DONATE_MULTIPLIER), # nolint: line_length_linter.
    PARASITE_CYCLE_STEAL_MULTIPLIER = as.factor(PARASITE_CYCLE_STEAL_MULTIPLIER), # nolint: line_length_linter.
    HOST_ONLY_FIRST_TASK_CREDIT = as.factor(HOST_ONLY_FIRST_TASK_CREDIT),
    SYM_ONLY_FIRST_TASK_CREDIT = as.factor(SYM_ONLY_FIRST_TASK_CREDIT),
    EVENTS_CFG_PATH = as.factor(EVENTS_CFG_PATH),
    SPATIAL_STRUCT_MODE = as.factor(SPATIAL_STRUCT_MODE),
    SPATIAL_STRUCT_CFG_PATH = as.factor(SPATIAL_STRUCT_CFG_PATH)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    task_credit = paste0(
      "H", HOST_ONLY_FIRST_TASK_CREDIT,
      "S", SYM_ONLY_FIRST_TASK_CREDIT
    ),
    interaction_multiplier = as.factor(PARASITE_CYCLE_STEAL_MULTIPLIER),
    environment = case_when(
      SPATIAL_STRUCT_MODE == "well-mixed" ~ "well-mixed",
      SPATIAL_STRUCT_CFG_PATH == "detour_wm2500_d7500x1.mat" ~ "detour_wm2500_d7500x1", # nolint: line_length_linter.
      SPATIAL_STRUCT_CFG_PATH == "detour_wm2500_d1875x4.mat" ~ "detour_wm2500_d1875x4",  # nolint: line_length_linter.
      SPATIAL_STRUCT_CFG_PATH == "detour_wm5000_d5000x1.mat" ~ "detour_wm5000_d5000x1", # nolint: line_length_linter.
      SPATIAL_STRUCT_CFG_PATH == "detour_wm5000_d1250x4.mat" ~ "detour_wm5000_d1250x4", # nolint: line_length_linter.
      SPATIAL_STRUCT_CFG_PATH == "detour_wm7500_d2500x1.mat" ~ "detour_wm7500_d2500x1", # nolint: line_length_linter.
      SPATIAL_STRUCT_CFG_PATH == "detour_wm7500_d625x4.mat" ~ "detour_wm7500_d625x4", # nolint: line_length_linter.
      SPATIAL_STRUCT_CFG_PATH == "cycle.mat" ~ "cycle",
      .default = "unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    environment = factor(
      environment,
      levels = c(
        "well-mixed",
        "detour_wm7500_d625x4",
        "detour_wm7500_d2500x1",
        "detour_wm5000_d1250x4",
        "detour_wm5000_d5000x1",
        "detour_wm2500_d1875x4",
        "detour_wm2500_d7500x1",
        "cycle"
      )
    ),
    treatment = paste0(
      environment, "_", VERTICAL_TRANSMISSION
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = as.factor(
      treatment
    )
  )
```

#### Symbiont interaction values

```{r}
sym_int_vals_path <-  paste(
  working_directory,

  "symbiont_interaction_values.csv",

)
sym_int_vals_data <- read_csv(sym_int_vals_path)

sym_int_vals_data <- sym_int_vals_data %>%

    PARASITE_CYCLE_STEAL_MULTIPLIER = as.factor(PARASITE_CYCLE_STEAL_MULTIPLIER), # nolint: line_length_linter.
    HEALTH_TYPE = as.factor(HEALTH_TYPE),
    PARASITE_CYCLE_LOSS_PROP = as.factor(PARASITE_CYCLE_LOSS_PROP),
    HEALTH_INTERACTION_CHANCE = as.factor(HEALTH_INTERACTION_CHANCE),
    PARASITE_BASE_CYCLE_PROP = as.factor(PARASITE_BASE_CYCLE_PROP),

  ) %>%
  mutate(
    environment = case_when(

      SPATIAL_STRUCT_CFG_PATH == "detour_wm2500_d1875x4.mat" ~ "detour_wm2500_d1875x4",  # nolint: line_length_linter.
      SPATIAL_STRUCT_CFG_PATH == "detour_wm5000_d5000x1.mat" ~ "detour_wm5000_d5000x1", # nolint: line_length_linter.
      SPATIAL_STRUCT_CFG_PATH == "detour_wm5000_d1250x4.mat" ~ "detour_wm5000_d1250x4", # nolint: line_length_linter.
      SPATIAL_STRUCT_CFG_PATH == "detour_wm7500_d2500x1.mat" ~ "detour_wm7500_d2500x1", # nolint: line_length_linter.

# Give each seed a rep_id based on its super mutualist prop
sym_int_vals_data <- sym_int_vals_data %>%
  group_by(

    "Hist_-0.4",
    "Hist_-0.5",
    "Hist_-0.6",
    "Hist_-0.7",
    "Hist_-0.8",
    "Hist_-0.9",

    "Hist_0.0",
    "Hist_0.1",
    "Hist_0.2",
    "Hist_0.3",
    "Hist_0.4",
    "Hist_0.5",
    "Hist_0.6",
    "Hist_0.7",
    "Hist_0.8",
    "Hist_0.9"
  ) %>%
  rename(total_syms = count) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(
      SEED,
      VERTICAL_TRANSMISSION,
      environment,
      treatment,
      total_syms,
      super_mutualist_prop,
      rep_id
    ),
    names_to = "int_val_range",
    values_to = "int_val_count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    int_val_range = as.factor(int_val_range)
  )
```

Summarize interaction value ranges:
- Collapse bins to fewer categories, matching with ALife 2025 tag paper bins.

```{r}
long_sym_int_vals_data <- long_sym_int_vals_data %>%
  # Recategorize
  mutate(
    int_val_range_reduced = case_when(
      int_val_range == "Hist_-1" ~ "-1.0 to -0.8 (Parasitic)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_-0.9" ~ "-1.0 to -0.8 (Parasitic)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_-0.8" ~ "-0.8 to -0.6 (Parasitic)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_-0.7" ~ "-0.8 to -0.6 (Parasitic)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_-0.6" ~ "-0.6 to -0.4 (Detrimental)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_-0.5" ~ "-0.6 to -0.4 (Detrimental)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_-0.4" ~ "-0.4 to -0.2 (Detrimental)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_-0.3" ~ "-0.4 to -0.2 (Detrimental)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_-0.2" ~ "-0.2 to 0 (Nearly neutral)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_-0.1" ~ "-0.2 to 0 (Nearly neutral)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_0.0" ~ "0 to 0.2 (Nearly neutral)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_0.1" ~ "0 to 0.2 (Nearly neutral)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_0.2" ~ "0.2 to 0.4 (Positive)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_0.3" ~ "0.2 to 0.4 (Positive)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_0.4" ~ "0.4 to 0.6 (Positive)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_0.5" ~ "0.4 to 0.6 (Positive)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_0.6" ~ "0.6 to 0.8 (Mutualistic)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_0.7" ~ "0.6 to 0.8 (Mutualistic)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_0.8" ~ "0.8 to 1.0 (Mutualistic)",
      int_val_range == "Hist_0.9" ~ "0.8 to 1.0 (Mutualistic)",
      .default = "unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    int_val_range_reduced = factor(
      int_val_range_reduced,
      levels = c(
        "-1.0 to -0.8 (Parasitic)",
        "-0.8 to -0.6 (Parasitic)",
        "-0.6 to -0.4 (Detrimental)",
        "-0.4 to -0.2 (Detrimental)",
        "-0.2 to 0 (Nearly neutral)",
        "0 to 0.2 (Nearly neutral)",
        "0.2 to 0.4 (Positive)",
        "0.4 to 0.6 (Positive)",
        "0.6 to 0.8 (Mutualistic)",
        "0.8 to 1.0 (Mutualistic)"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "-1.0:-0.8 (Parasitic)",
        "-0.8:-0.6 (Parasitic)",
        "-0.6:-0.4 (Detrimental)",
        "-0.4:-0.2 (Detrimental)",
        "-0.2:0.0 (Nearly neutral)",
        "0.0:0.2 (Nearly neutral)",
        "0.2:0.4 (Positive)",
        "0.4:0.6 (Positive)",
        "0.6:0.8 (Mutualistic)",
        "0.8:1.0 (Mutualistic)"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  # Collapse
  group_by(
    SEED,
    total_syms, # Note: total syms will be same for all rows of same seed.
    VERTICAL_TRANSMISSION,
    environment,
    treatment,
    int_val_range_reduced,
    rep_id
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    int_val_count = sum(int_val_count)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    int_val_prop = int_val_count / total_syms,
    VT = VERTICAL_TRANSMISSION,
    env = environment
  )
```

## Extinctions

If a run was configured without a maximum symbiont age, it is possible that even
if symbionts are not extinct, they are not capable of independent reproduction.
I.e., they can lose their ability to reproduce on their own, disengage from their host,
and then become "vistigial" free-riders.

```{r}
sym_min_pop_sizes <- time_data %>%
  group_by(SEED) %>%
  slice_min(
    OrgCounts_hosted_sym_count,
    n = 1
  ) %>%
  slice_min(
    update,
    n = 1
  )

reps_with_extinct_syms <- sym_min_pop_sizes %>%
  group_by(
    treatment
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    reps_with_extinct_syms = sum(OrgCounts_hosted_sym_count == 0)
  )

host_min_pop_sizes <- time_data %>%
  group_by(SEED) %>%
  slice_min(
    OrgCounts_host_count,
    n = 1
  ) %>%
  slice_min(
    update,
    n = 1
  )

reps_with_extinct_hosts <- host_min_pop_sizes %>%
  group_by(
    treatment
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    reps_with_extinct_hosts = sum(OrgCounts_host_count == 0)
  )

extinctions <- full_join(
  reps_with_extinct_syms,
  reps_with_extinct_hosts
)
extinctions <- extinctions %>%
  arrange(
    desc(reps_with_extinct_hosts), desc(reps_with_extinct_syms)
  )
extinction_table <- kable(extinctions) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "striped")
save_kable(
  extinction_table,
  paste(
    plot_dir,
    "extinctions.pdf",
    sep = "/"
  )
)
```

## Symbiont interaction values

```{r}
tenhelix <- c(
  "#891901",
  "#B50142",
  "#D506AD",
  "#AB08FF",
  "#5731FD",
  "#4755FF",
  "#42bcf5",
  "#42e0f5",
  "#9af1fc",
  "#c5f6fc"
)
sym_int_val_props_plt <- long_sym_int_vals_data %>%
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(
      fill = int_val_range_reduced,
      x = rep_id,
      y = int_val_count,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(
    position = "fill",
    na.rm = TRUE,
    width = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Behavior",
    values = tenhelix
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Replicate",
    y = "Proportion of symbiont population"
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    env ~ VT,
    labeller = label_both
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
regional_endosym_occuppancy_plt <- detour_graph_region_data %>%

    )

    axes = "all_x"

  )
```
